title: Compute brief - 26 October 2026
description: The compute build went to the capital markets on one Monday: Anthropic's public S-1 shows up to $120.5 billion of SpaceXAI GPU rent and a $125.2 billion Broadcom TPU lease, Meta launched a $95 billion equity plan, and SpaceX committed to a $40 billion Apollo GPU lease while Elon Musk said 200 plus neoclouds face consolidation. SK Hyper wants $350 billion for 5 GW in Korea. Tape: 68 confirms, 2 ticks (DigitalOcean MI355X spot $5.50 to $2.97, MI350X spot $3.50 to $2.46), 0 NEW.
og_kicker: The compute build now runs on equity, leases and rent, and the market is picking who gets funded
lede: Monday turned the capital question into filings. Anthropic's public S-1 shows it builds almost nothing itself and rents nearly everything: up to $120.5 billion with SpaceXAI into 2029, about $3.1 billion a month once capacity lands in December, a $125.2 billion five-year Broadcom accelerator lease that cannot be cancelled, $44.6 billion with Nscale and $41.3 billion with Lambda. Meta launched a $95 billion equity plan, $35 billion now and $60 billion at-the-market from 2027, with NVIDIA, AMD and Broadcom offering to buy up to $5 billion of it. SpaceX filed a binding commitment for a $40 billion Apollo-managed GPU finance lease, and Elon Musk said debt markets have shut for neoclouds without other revenue; CoreWeave and Nebius fell about 4%. The neocloud rent in Anthropic's book carries conditions: Nscale must find financing and $34.9 billion of the Lambda deal falls away if Lambda cannot secure the facility lease. On the public tape, DigitalOcean cut AMD spot: MI355X to $2.97 from $5.50 and MI350X to $2.46 from $3.50. Everything else confirmed.
